# Kaizen Supplies Ltd

> Kaizen Supplies Ltd is a creative marketing agency based at Plot 12 Malcolm X Ave, Kololo, Kampala, Uganda. The agency helps organizations build lasting brands through strategy, storytelling, content creation, digital marketing, photography, video, live production and experiential campaigns.

## Kaizen Chat

Kaizen Chat is a product of Kaizen Supplies Ltd for businesses that serve customers through WhatsApp. It provides instant, business-approved replies, captures customer names and enquiries, shares approved information such as prices, opening hours, locations and payment details, and keeps conversations organised for a team.

- Product type: WhatsApp business assistant and customer-service automation platform
- Primary market: Businesses in Uganda
- Core capabilities: instant replies, enquiry capture, official WhatsApp Business number support, shared team inboxes, quick replies, catalog tagging and business app integrations
- Published plans: Baby at UGX 20,000 per week, Starter at UGX 75,000 per month and Business at UGX 150,000 per month; enterprise pricing is tailored
- Setup: Approximately three to five working days after the required business information is supplied
- Contact: info@kaizensuppliesltd.com

### Kaizen Chat frequently asked questions

- What is Kaizen Chat? A WhatsApp assistant that answers common customer questions instantly and saves customer details for the business.
- Is an existing WhatsApp Business account required? No. It connects through the official Meta Cloud API. A business may register a new number or migrate an existing business number.
- Is Kaizen Chat AI? It follows questions and answers approved by the business so that replies remain predictable and on-brand.
- What does it cost? There is a one-time setup fee plus a message pack. WhatsApp may charge for certain message types. Current plan prices appear on the official product page.
- Are technical skills required? No. The Kaizen Chat team builds it and the business approves it.
- How long does setup take? Approximately three to five working days after the required business information is supplied.
- Can customers pay through Kaizen Chat? It can share Mobile Money, Airtel Money or bank payment instructions, but it does not collect or hold the payment.
- What happens when a message pack runs out? The business is warned beforehand and can top up.
- Who can see customer information? The business and the authorized team members it chooses.
